title: daphne linoides
intro: Daphne linoides, commonly known as the Fingered Daphne or Spurge Laurel, is a plant species belonging to the family Thymelaeaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Daphne linoides include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and potentially exhibiting anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Daphne linoides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
